components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default CTA; charcoal on paper, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: oklch(0.988 0.003 106.5); background: oklch(0.228 0.013 107.4); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.228 0.013 107.4 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; paper fill with line border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1); background: oklch(1 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.93 0.007 106.5); border-radius: 2.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.966 0.005 106.5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9 / 0.3); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Inactive nav item with tabular index prefix.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.58 0.031 107.3); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-index { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: This system treats the site as a working surface, not a marketing funnel. Recruiters should read role, location, and credibility in seconds; everything else supports that scan without decorative chrome. Playfulness lives in intentional details (route motion, tabular nav indices, touch-target craft), not in section templates or hero widgets. The palette is deliberately restrained: ink on paper with olive-tinted neutrals from the shadcn olive base.
keyCharacteristics: Recruiter-first hierarchy: name and reachability before personality routes
Ink-on-paper neutrals with whisper for secondary copy only when contrast holds
Serif display (Roboto Slab) over sans body (Geist)
Flat surfaces at rest; hover/focus lift reserved for interactive elements
Sharp minimal components: links carry navigation; buttons stay rare
Route transitions (GSAP) as the primary motion signature

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Light-mode body background stays true white (chroma 0). No cream, sand, parchment, or warm near-white fills.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: Muted foreground is for short secondary lines (nav inactive, captions, tabular indices). Body copy stays ink unless a contrast audit passes at 4.5:1.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Charcoal and ink carry hierarchy; no second saturated accent color until a deliberate brand moment earns it.

rules.name: The Slab Name Rule
rules.body: The person's name and primary route headings use display serif; everything operational stays sans.

rules.name: The Flat Scale Rule
rules.body: Maintain ≥1.25 ratio between type steps; avoid stacking similar sizes with no weight change.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No ambient card shadows on static content. Cards are not the default layout affordance.

rules.name: The Hover-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation motion appears on interactive elements in response to state, never on passive paragraphs or section wrappers.

dos: Do keep About and Contact hire signals above the fold on their routes: name, role, location, clear next step.
Do use ink for readable body copy and reserve whisper for short secondary lines with verified contrast.
Do use serif display for identity headings and sans for UI and supporting text.
Do expand hit areas on nav links (hit-area-8) and show visible focus rings on interactive controls.
Do treat GSAP route transitions as the primary motion signature; add reduced-motion alternatives for any new animation.
Do prefer spacing and type rhythm over cards, badges, and decorative wrappers.
donts: Don't use SaaS landing patterns: hero metrics, identical feature card grids, buzzword copy, or gradient accents as decoration.
Don't ship generic AI portfolio tells: cream or sand body backgrounds, gradient text, uppercase eyebrow on every section, or numbered section markers as default scaffolding across the site.
Don't dump a PDF resume on the web: dense bullet walls without hierarchy or scan path.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on lists or callouts.
Don't apply glassmorphism, gradient text, or identical icon+heading+text card grids.
Don't gate content visibility on entrance animations; content must be readable if motion is reduced or paused.
Don't use muted whisper for long paragraphs; bump toward ink when contrast is borderline.
